non_dependency_updates.details:
Wire the top of the customer dashboard to real data: the KPI row (active customers, new customers, revenue, AOV with period-over-period deltas) and the revenue-over-time area chart with a granularity toggle (daily/weekly/monthly). Includes number/currency formatting, loading skeletons, empty states for periods with no data, and per-widget error states with a retry action.

Scope boundary: these two widget groups only. Segment table, cohort panel, and final page assembly are the sibling task.
Definition of done: both widget groups render correctly against seeded customer data, and each has storybook/test coverage for loading, empty, and error states.
non_dependency_updates.name: Customer dashboard: KPI row & revenue trend widgets

non_dependency_updates.details:
Wire the analytical widgets of the log dashboard to real data: the error-rate time series, request throughput series, and p50/p95/p99 latency chart with a shared time axis and consistent bucketing. Includes severity-aware coloring, loading skeletons, empty states for quiet periods, and per-widget error states with retry.

Scope boundary: these three time-series widgets only. Tables, breakdowns, and anomaly overlays are the sibling task.
Definition of done: all three charts render correctly against seeded log data and stay visually aligned on the shared time axis at every breakpoint.
non_dependency_updates.name: Log dashboard: error rate, throughput & latency charts

non_dependency_updates.details:
Write automated integration tests that take fixture inputs through each pipeline to the API response layer (no browser): (a) upload a fixture CSV, run ingestion, and assert aggregated metrics match hand-computed expectations; (b) ingest fixture logs, run normalization and rollups, and assert error rate, latency percentiles, and top fingerprints match expectations; (c) assert quarantine rows and reconciliation counts for deliberately malformed inputs.

Scope boundary: pipeline-to-API assertions only. Browser rendering and CI wiring are the sibling task.
Definition of done: each test seeds its own isolated dataset, runs in the containerized test database, and passes deterministically on repeated runs.
non_dependency_updates.name: Pipeline-to-API integration tests (CSV & log fixtures)
